mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", endpoint AS "endpoint" FROM driver WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND endpoint IS NOT NULL AND endpoint <> ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO driver_health (driver_id, checked_at, healthy, latency_ms, message) VALUES (#{driverId}, now(), #{healthy}, #{latencyMs}, #{message})

INSERT INTO device_state (tenant_id, resource_id, status, online, last_heartbeat, updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, di.resource_id, 'idle', #{online}, CASE WHEN #{online} THEN to_timestamp(#{nowMillis} / 1000.0) ELSE NULL END, now() FROM device_instance di WHERE di.driver_id = #{driverId} AND di.deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET online = EXCLUDED.online, last_heartbeat = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.online THEN EXCLUDED.last_heartbeat ELSE device_state.last_heartbeat END, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO alert_state (tenant_id, fingerprint, status, updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|' || r.id, 'open', now() FROM device_state ds JOIN resource_node r ON r.id = ds.resource_id WHERE ds.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ds.online = false AND ds.last_heartbeat IS NOT NULL AND ds.last_heartbeat < now() - (#{offlineMs} || ' milliseconds')::interval ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', closed_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_state a SET status = 'closed', closed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.status = 'open' AND a.fingerprint LIKE 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_state ds JOIN resource_node r ON r.id = ds.resource_id WHERE ds.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a.fingerprint = 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|' || r.id AND ds.online = true)
